notes: Measured model: Gaussian blur of the alpha (sigma^2 = 0.635*|choke| px^2, transparent outside the layer), then levels around a fixed level 7/8 (choke > 0) or 1/8 (choke < 0) with ramp width 3/(4|choke|), ends clamped to [0,1] (choke 0 = identity); colour = un-premultiplied original * new alpha (newly covered pixels are black, as in AE). Fitted on 2 visible settings (3, -4): the sigma ~ sqrt(|choke|) law, the fixed 7/8 / 1/8 centre and the 4|choke|/3 gain are consistent across both but extrapolation to other values (and |choke| < 3, where the clamps take over) is a model, not measured. AE's true kernel is slightly flatter-topped than a Gaussian (free-kernel fit), residual max 9/255 on corners. View 2 (Matte) renders the choked alpha as opaque grey (not checked against AE). Pass 0 stores the horizontal blur as 16-bit fixed point packed in R/G (Rive keeps intermediate passes in RGBA8).
